$comment: Version index for the Rageforge Mirror Cube. The website reads this as a fallback and uses the GitHub Releases API as the primary source. Newest version first.

changes: Deeper default recursion (recursionDepth 4 to 6, maxReflections 10 to 12, maxRenderPasses 48 to 64) for a noticeably closer-to-infinite mirror-in-mirror effect out of the box
Added a thin dark edge to the Mirror Cube block and item texture so placed cubes read as distinct blocks instead of blending into each other
No changes to mixins, rendering code, or block logic in this release
First public release of the Mirror Cube (all six faces reflective)
